refactor.production: Prepared pool separated from legacy pooled reset. Frozen EF model/options bind one owner, context type, schema mode and initializer version. Snapshot comparison and capture separated from ownership; sorted binary-row hashes retain counts/digests rather than seed payload. Logins are private immutable values, admin sources are never handed to workloads. Exact datasource identity uses one narrowly scoped pinned Npgsql options API because endpoint equality cannot prove source ownership.
refactor.tests: One three-table public oracle plus focused migration/caller/permission/failure/catalog cases. Fast manifest comparison tests use independently supplied differences; PostgreSQL corruption cases calibrate the actual capture boundary. No score-driven test consolidation.
